articles.company_name: MDU Resources Group Inc. Common Stock (Holding Company)
articles.summary: Consolidated net income of $14.0 million, compared with $18.4 million in the same quarter last year Earnings per share of $0.07, compared with $0.09 in the third quarter of 2025 Adjusted earnings per share of $0.08, compared with $0.09 in the third quarter of 2025 2026 guidance reaffirmed; earnings per share in the range of $0.93 to $1.00 Positive final investment decision reached on Bakken East Pipeline MDU Resources Group, Inc. (NYSE: MDU) today announced its financial results for the third quarter of 2026, highlighting stronger electric utility earnings and advancement of significant strategic growth initiatives designed to serve growing energy demand and create long-term value. "We continued to execute our CORE strategy during the third quarter, with strong performance from our electric utility while advancing significant investments that are designed to support growing energy needs and long-term value creation," said Nicole A. Kivisto, president and CEO of MDU Resources.
articles.title: MDU Resources Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results; Reaffirms Guidance
